verdict.rationale: Treasury Prime's docs cover fraud-adjacent tooling — ACH returns, card decline reasons, cardholder disputes under Reg E, card auth loop for real-time accept/reject, and account locking — but nowhere do the docs state who bears the financial liability for ACH return fraud, card disputes, or ATO losses (bank vs. program vs. platform). The liability-split economics a finance lead needs are simply absent from the evidence.
